content: मोदक {%a.%} (-का, -की|{%f.%}) [मोदयति-मुद् णिच् ण्वुल्] .²1 Pleasing, delighting, gladdening. .²2 Glad, delighted. .{@-कः, -कम्@} .²1 A sweetmeat in general; <ls>Y. 1. 289</ls> (<ab>com.</ab> मोदकाः लड्डुकाः). .²2 A kind of pill (in medicine). .{@-कः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a mixed tribe (sprung from a Kṣatriya father and a Śūdra mother).
